releaseNotes: My Diary 1.0.189: Private Locker writing-only, encrypted search/editing, four-digit Diary-style PIN, Pattern, Favourite Name recovery and separate Android Keystore fingerprint. Diary Lock remains unchanged.
webReleaseNotes: My Diary Web Update 286: Private Locker Lock Off / Lock On controls were not mounted in the visible Locker screen. This publication restores the control row beside Pattern/Fingerprint without changing Diary Lock or Note Lock.
